scope: Reference-guided reusable Godot display components; isolated theme, no global theme switch, main scene integration, evaluator, persistence or navigation model.

scrim.mouse_policy: Decorative underlay ignores input; an integrating modal host must block background input and manage focus.

fonts.provenance: Unchanged RC-012 Noto Serif 2.015 binary/resources and OFL; no new font or reference-font-identification claim.

type_variations.RCPrimary: Button with raw StyleBoxTexture; helper action(primary=true) preferred for proportional tip sizing
type_variations.RCSocket: Button without background; component adds independently sliced paint
type_variations.RCCardLive: Button without background; component adds independently sliced paint
type_variations.RCPointed: Button without background; component adds proportional-caps paint
type_variations.RCSecondaryLive: Button without background; component adds independently sliced paint
type_variations.RCMenu: PanelContainer with 36px content padding beyond 24px painted caps

menu.actions: Pointed turquoise Resume uses primary=true; navy Options, Store and Quit use primary=false. See the primary and secondary slicing entries.

superseded_revision.reason: Owner requested reverting the shared button-frame change while retaining the corrected padding and centered title.

panel_and_card.note: Theme StyleBoxTexture fallback draws source caps in logical pixels. Helpers use independently specified destination caps; square corners remain intact at 72 and 137 socket sizes.

primary.helper_destination_rule: Source caps multiplied by live control height /128. End tips retain uniform aspect while central face expands.

slicing.texture_sharing: Piles use frames/panel.png directly. The unused pile.png duplicate and non-node state SVG runtime exports are retired; StateLayer draws cues and Map retains node SVGs.

minimum_sizes_logical_px.card_height: Minimum 312; follows actual wrapped content minimum plus 32px margins when a long title needs more height.

states.composable: Independent state_layer draws shape cues after content. selected corner notch, dashed focused corners, double/corner powered collar, invalid cross, unavailable barred circle. Exact board port centers remain unobstructed.
states.actual_focus: State overlay also observes Control focus_entered/focus_exited. focused=true independently forces a specimen or presentation focus ring.
states.activation: disabled or unavailable disables the BaseButton and suppresses ordinary pressed callbacks. Disabled buttons are not ordinary tab targets; unavailable reason is visible in surrounding live text. Combined focused+unavailable is explicit display coverage, not an integration decision about inspection.
states.no_board_badges: Only live BEGIN and END allowed inside sockets. Card temporary/upgraded text and markers never transfer to sockets.

layout.decorative_mouse_filter: IGNORE for textures, paint, state overlays, layout-only containers and labels.
layout.interactive_scrollers: Card DescriptionScroll and modal BodyScroll retain scrolling input. They are intentional interactive surfaces, not decorative children.
layout.cards: Cost/name header, symbol, type, separate value label, scrollable effect, card-only temporary/upgraded markers. Larger hands belong in a horizontal ScrollContainer.
layout.modal: Title and fixed actions outside vertical BodyScroll; Close and optional confirmation remain present after scrolling.
layout.native360: Use actual native font sizes; scroll page/hand/details without uniformly shrinking the full 720 design layout.
layout.unbounded_action_labels: Default native Button text expands its minimum width; callers should supply concise live action labels or a wrapping compound control. Long descriptions and names are card/dialog content.
layout.slider_knob: Existing RC-012 energy SVG drawn at 26px over the default grabber position, inside 44px-high input control; follows live value.

source_export_relationships.method: Editable code shipped unchanged; nine-slice drawing, no raster editing.
Editable geometric overlay code, no separate new icon library.
Hand-authored resource assembly using runtime font/texture references.

limitations: Separate isolated Godot evidence required before readiness claim.
Inherited painted-art provenance/licence limitations remain those of source-export-map.json and retained r004.
Reference approval does not approve reconstructed assets.
RC-016A owns evaluator, gameplay/control migration and no-cast/inspection choices; RC-016 and RC-042 own integration.
